description.zh-CN: 代码插件示例：给检视器加一个「统计」标签，列出选中图层的子图层数、效果、绑定了用户属性 / 挂了脚本 / 做了关键帧的字段数，以及它引用的文件。只读，不改文档。
description.en: Code plugin example: adds a "Stats" tab to the inspector listing the selected layer's descendants, effects, how many fields are bound to user properties / scripted / keyframed, and the files it references. Read-only — never touches the document.
